summary.text: Lisa Callan is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 5-Position 2, where she has served since January 2019, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
She is a former Issaquah School District board member who worked as a Boeing engineer and project manager.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Callan, before her election in 2018, served as a school board director in the Issaquah School District, worked as a Boeing engineer and project manager, and consulted in software development.
Ballotpedia lists her Issaquah school board service as 2013 to 2019 and a bachelor's degree in math from Northern Arizona University.
Callan took office in the House on January 14, 2019, succeeding Paul Graves.

Her House Democrats profile lists her as Vice Chair of the Capital Budget Committee and a member of the Education Committee and the Children, Youth & Families Committee, and as co-chair of the Children & Youth Behavioral Health Work Group.
